selection.scope: One A76-primary isolated CPU measurement over the full eight-case/302-call decode RMSNorm population; no A55 lane, NPU run, model run, or deployment reconnection in this protocol.

four_questions.authenticity: PASS: Gemma4 RMSNorm direct-scale and scale-free semantics, normalized widths 256/512/2560, row multiplicities, and 302 calls/model-forward are census-backed.
four_questions.bottleneck: PASS_METHOD_AND_EXCLUSION_VALUE: no prior claim says RMSNorm is the OPE4 bottleneck. The measurement tests whether the complete CPU-side population is too small to be a major contributor and establishes an independent upper-bound instrument.
four_questions.capability: PASS_DESIGN: the measured A76 exposes fphp/asimdhp; IEEE FP16 input/output with FP32 reduction is implementable with GCC 11.4 and NEON without BF16, i8mm, SVE, or SME.
four_questions.deliverability: PASS_ISOLATED_ONLY: the result can report correctness, three baselines, PMU context, population-weighted time, an OPE4 fraction, and a lineage-separated PC K1 method comparison. It cannot claim RKLLM deployment acceleration.

ope0_bandwidth_ceiling.evidence_limit: Single formal OPE0 segment; owner waived replication.

ope3_bus_access_adjudication.preserved_finding: BUS_ACCESS counts transferred data beats, not cache-line transactions; the old count*64 gate remains rejected.

semantic_contract.operation: For each contiguous row x of length N: r = 1/sqrt(mean(float32(x)^2) + 1e-6); output = fp16(float32(x) * r * optional_float32(scale)).
semantic_contract.scaled_weight_dtype: IEEE float16 loaded and promoted to float32
semantic_contract.scale_free_semantics: v_norm has no learned scale and receives a null weight
semantic_contract.layout: row-major contiguous, normalized axis stride one
semantic_contract.pc_lineage_difference: PC K1 formal results use BF16 on sm_89. This board protocol uses FP16 because the measured A76 has FP16 arithmetic but no required BF16 contract; only semantics and methodology are compared.

analytic_account.interpretation: This is a compulsory-byte analytic floor for the isolated FP16 population, not a prediction of closed RKLLM internal activation traffic or runtime cost.

scalar_ref.role: correctness oracle and timed scalar baseline
scalar_ref.implementation: plain scalar FP32 reduction and direct optional scale; function-scoped vectorization disabled

autovec_o3.implementation: the same semantic loop compiled with -O3 -mcpu=cortex-a76 and normal GCC auto-vectorization

neon_fp16.implementation: AArch64 NEON loads/conversion with FP32 square reduction, scalar reciprocal square root per row, and NEON normalize/optional direct-scale store

correctness_protocol.scale_distribution: uniform[-0.5,96.0] generated in float32 then cast to float16
correctness_protocol.comparisons: autovec_o3 and neon_fp16 are each compared elementwise with scalar_ref for every case/distribution/seed
structural_assertions: output shape and contiguous layout match
input and scale buffers are unchanged
scale-free cases receive no scale pointer
correctness_protocol.repair_kill: After three candidate correctness repair iterations, stop and retain the failing corpus. Harness-only faults may be fixed with an explicit attempt receipt before formal timing.

implementation_identity.source_lock_rule: Implementation does not exist at preregistration freeze. Before any formal timing, write a source-lock receipt with SHA-256 for all three paths and verify the preregistration hash; any later source change requires a new transparent preregistration revision.

measurement_protocol.population_sequence: Execute the eight case types in their frozen 211/35/7/20/20/4/4/1 multiplicities; one sequence is one 302-call model-forward projection.
measurement_protocol.streaming_ring_reason: Rotate 16 independent 3.84 MB frames so the primary population sequence is not a tiny-buffer cache-residency benchmark.
measurement_protocol.interleave: Use all six permutations of scalar_ref/autovec_o3/neon_fp16 round-robin for both per-case and population timing.
measurement_protocol.frequency_gate: Every timed-window sample for the A76 policy containing CPU7 must be at least 95% of recorded max.
measurement_protocol.thermal_gate: No timed-window thermal sample may equal or exceed the lowest enabled trip point recorded for its zone.
measurement_protocol.stability_gate: IQR/p50 must be <=0.30 for all primary population variants; one unchanged retry is allowed only for an unstable segment and is not replication.
measurement_protocol.owner_instruction: 不需要复测，取消同日复测，只测一次
measurement_protocol.controller_clock: Record controller timestamps before and after the board process; use board CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW for durations.
measurement_protocol.smoke_policy: No separate performance smoke and no second formal segment. Randomized correctness is the only pre-timing execution gate.

tier_a.scope: Report per-case and 302-call population values. The population value is primary.
tier_a.interpretation: RMSNorm includes reduction and reciprocal-square-root work; a low bandwidth-relative score is not by itself a defect or a DRAM bottleneck proof.

tier_b.scope: Collect once for the 302-call streaming population after valid timing; no per-case perf matrix.
tier_b.bus_access_policy: Preserve the OPE3 rejection of count*64. Pre-register count*8 only as a beat-size hypothesis diagnostic and report its ratio; it is not an analytic-backing acceptance gate.
tier_b.required_gate: All four named events must be numeric for all three variants; no raw-event substitution or post-measurement normalization.
tier_b.perf_record: Not required: OPE3 already established record/report capability, and this stage asks a population upper-bound question rather than symbol-level hotspot discovery.

ope4.metric: C02 aggregate consecutive NORMAL callback interval
ope4.guard: The ratio compares an isolated CPU instrument with a closed NPU model stage. It is not a component decomposition and must not be subtracted from TPOT.

pc_k1.lineage: RTX 4060 Laptop / sm_89 / BF16 / Triton K1
pc_k1.use: Methodology and semantic-contract context only; never rank the FP16 A76 number against this BF16 GPU number as a hardware win/loss.

outcome_rules.measurement_valid: All source locks, 144 correctness comparisons, three timing variants, population timing, telemetry, governor restore, named perf events, and single-segment identity pass.
outcome_rules.major_gap_claim_prohibited: Even a large isolated ratio cannot be attributed to RKLLM without a new carrier that proves the runtime executes equivalent RMSNorm work on CPU.
outcome_rules.time_kill: Stop and write a bounded result if implementation plus one formal segment exceeds two working days.

claim_limits: This protocol is frozen before candidate implementation and before any OPE5 board execution.
The candidate is a cross-ISA CPU instrument, not part of the RKLLM W8A8 deployment path; no board-model speedup may be claimed.
FP16 board and BF16 sm_89 results are lineage-separated and not directly performance-comparable.
The OPE0 bandwidth denominator and OPE4 TPOT both inherit owner-waived single-segment evidence strength.
One formal segment is authorized; replication remains explicitly unsatisfied and no same-day retest is scheduled.
No A55 comparator, NPU run, RKLLM model run, 3-core LLM, quality evaluation, driver/kernel/shared-library change, or frozen artifact mutation is authorized.
